decisions.reason: The buzzer package and supported-voltage details do not alter the independently specified LED power, data, or component interface.
The selected passive buzzer has no necessary effect on the LED array board's LED count, package, mounting, or part selection.
The buzzer selection does not change the sensor-board connector matrix or its specified module connections.
The passive buzzer's dimensions, mounting, and voltage compatibility do not affect the panel reset input.
The buzzer component selection does not change the panel button or switch connectors, GPIO assignments, or mounting.
The buzzer specification is unrelated to whether or how the PIR connector is provided.
The buzzer's supported voltages do not change the SPS30 SEL connection or I2C operating mode.
The passive buzzer selection does not alter the capacitive-touch sensors, connectors, or GPIO assignments.
Listing a buzzer compatible with 3V, 3.3V, and 5V does not select its operating rail or necessarily change which system rails require current monitoring.
The buzzer listing is compatible with existing system voltages and does not change the AXP2101, required rails, or battery power path.
The source does not state that the buzzer must be powered in standalone USB mode or add it to the standalone 3.3V load set.
Selecting an SMD passive buzzer does not necessarily change the three-board architecture or the established roles and exclusions of the main and sensor boards.
